title: 第1章 我怎么被绑票了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我不会被绑架了吧？”

林珝睁开眼，花了几秒钟才确认自己还活着。

入眼处是漏风的破木屋，泥巴糊成的墙壁挂满了蜘蛛网，身下是粗糙的硬木板，连条像样的被子都没有。

他摸遍全身，口袋是空的。手机、钥匙，所有带金属的东西都消失了，身上多了一件灰扑扑的粗布袍子，袖口早就磨起了毛边。

“嘶……”后脑勺的疼痛让他呆坐了会儿，想起出事前，他正在剧组拍一场古装戏，不慎从两层楼高的地方坠落。

按说片场出了事故，要么叫救护车，要么封锁现场，避免消息传出去。

可无论哪种，都不该让他一个人醒来，躺在这间陌生的破木屋里。

除非，这根本不是剧组的安排。

林珝闭眼缓了几秒，然后撑着身体站起来，吃力地挪到门口，才发现大门居然从外面锁死了。

“有人吗？”

他拍了两下门板。片刻后，一个壮汉拉开门栓，铁塔似的身子堵在门口，光线从背后灌进来，刺得林珝眯了下眼。

“吵什么吵，老实待着！”

壮汉的语气很冲，但真正让林珝闭嘴的，是他腰间那把刀。

他在剧组接触过上百把道具刀，铝合金片开不了这种刃

——刃口上那层细密的磨痕，绝对是真刀才有的质感，而且一定见过血！

林珝不自觉地退了一步。多年的片场经验告诉他，眼前这个杀气腾腾的家伙，绝不是剧组找来的群演。

“哥们，你这……”

“滚回去，没有小姐的命令，你哪儿都不能走！”

林珝没有回嘴，盯着对方手里的刀看了两秒，然后自己把门关上了。

整整两天，他只能窝在那间破烂的茅草屋里。门口二十四小时有人值守，除了到饭点的时候，壮汉会推门进来，扔给他一些粗粝的嚼裹，从不主动搭话。

饭点还算准时，说明对方暂时不打算饿死他。

只是那几个看守投来的眼神，却凶狠得好似几头狼。

看来自己如今的身份，更像是个囚徒。

为了搞清楚到底卷进了什么烂摊子，林珝开始趁壮汉送饭的间隙套话。尽管每次都招来一顿呵斥，好歹从只言片语中拼凑出了一些有用的信息。

这里是黑风寨，一个饱受战乱侵扰的土匪窝。

原身也叫林珝，是这座山寨的“姑爷”。

他老爹是另一个山寨的寨主，和这里的当家人交情不错，曾在酒桌上定下了娃娃亲。

后来老爹的山寨遭到围剿，在和乌勒人的交战中身中毒箭，临终前让他带着一纸婚书投奔黑风寨。

老寨主爱惜脸面，当面收下婚书，说是会尽快安排他与女儿完婚。

谁知洞房那晚，林珝刚跨进新娘的房门，还没来得及看清那位三小姐长什么模样，后脑勺就挨了一记闷棍。

Page (1/3)

"I won't be kidnapped, right?"

Lin Jue opened her eyes and took a few seconds to confirm that she was still alive.

The first thing you see is a drafty dilapidated wooden house, with mud walls covered with spider webs, rough hardwood boards underneath, and not even a decent quilt.

He felt all over his body, but his pockets were empty.The mobile phone, keys, and all metal objects disappeared, and there was a dusty coarse cloth robe on his body. The cuffs had long been frayed.

"Hiss..." The pain in the back of his head made him sit blankly for a while, remembering that before the accident, he was filming a costume drama on the set and accidentally fell from a height of two stories.

Ordinarily, if there was an accident on the set, one would either call an ambulance or seal off the scene to prevent the news from spreading.

But no matter what, he shouldn't be allowed to wake up alone in this strange shabby wooden house.

Unless, this is not the arrangement of the crew at all.

Lin Jue closed her eyes for a few seconds, then stood up and struggled to the door, only to find that the door was locked from the outside.

"Is there anyone?"

He tapped the door panel twice.A moment later, a strong man opened the door latch. His iron-tower-like body blocked the door, and light poured in from behind, making Lin Sui squint.

"Why are you making such a fuss? Just stay still!"

The strong man's tone was harsh, but what really shut up Lin Jue was the knife at his waist.

He has been exposed to hundreds of prop knives on the set, and aluminum alloy blades cannot open such blades.

——The layer of fine grinding marks on the edge of the blade definitely has the texture of a real knife, and it must have seen blood!

Lin Jue took a step back unconsciously.Years of experience on set told him that the murderous guy in front of him was definitely not an extra hired by the crew.

"Brother, you..."

"Go back, you can't go anywhere without the lady's order!"

Lin Jue didn't reply. He stared at the knife in the other person's hand for two seconds, and then closed the door himself.

For two whole days, he could only stay in that dilapidated thatched hut.There is someone on duty at the door 24 hours a day. Except when it's meal time, a strong man will open the door and come in, throw some rough chews to him, and never take the initiative to talk to him.

The meal was on time, which meant that the other party didn't plan to starve him to death for the time being.

But the looks from those guards were as fierce as wolves.

It seems that his current status is more like a prisoner.

In order to find out what kind of mess he was involved in, Lin Jue began to make excuses while the strong man was delivering food.Although he was scolded every time, he managed to piece together some useful information from the few words he said.

This is Heifeng Village, a bandit den that has been plagued by war.

His original name was Lin Jue, and he was the "uncle" of this village.

His father was the owner of another village, and he had a good relationship with the head of the village, and they once arranged a wedding at the wine table.

Later, my father's village was surrounded and suppressed, and he was poisoned by an arrow in a battle with the Ule people. Before his death, he asked him to take a marriage certificate and defect to Heifeng Village.

The old village leader cherished his face and accepted the marriage certificate in person, saying that he would arrange a marriage with his daughter as soon as possible.

Unexpectedly, on the night of the wedding, Lin Shui just stepped into the bride's room and before she could see clearly what the third lady looked like, she received a sap on the back of the head.
